content_html:
Watched #Mister …..
Tag line manam prema ni vethukuntu velthe preme manalni vethukuntu vasthundi but cinema original tag line meeru oka cinema ni chudalani ticket tesukunte vasthey 3 cinemalu mimalni ethukuntu vasthayi _/\_

assalu ee cinema ni Varun Tej ella opukunaado guda artham kavatledhu…..Srinu Vaytla maarademo anukoni cinema chudaniki ellina vaalaki eedu manam chachinaa maradu anee namakam balanga vasthundi

assalu anni char’s endhuku vasthayo theledhu vaalu em cheyali anukunaaro theledhu….aaalatho vaytla babu em cheyisdham anukunaado theledhu….its just rajiv udyogasri padhakam for all telugu char artists

assalu 2nd half lo aa Krishna Devaraya Vamsam episodes Highlight….2 hrs 40 mins movie ee 10 hrs nuncho chusthunaa feeling vasthundi……Climax epudepudda ani aassa ga edhuru chuse valaki 3 climaxes chusi raktha kaaneeree _/\_

naaku thelisi Vaytla ki chinapati nunchi Java Multi Threading Concept ante mozu anukuntaaa andhuke aaadhe format follow ayipothuntaadu cinema after cinema
